# Health Check Holidays

> Health Check Holidays pairs JCI-accredited hospital health screenings across
> Asia with a family holiday, at roughly half the cost of equivalent private
> screening in the United States.

Health Check Holidays Ltd is registered in England & Wales (company number
17079237), registered office 71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London,
WC2H 9JQ, United Kingdom.

**Status: pre-launch.** The platform is in development and is not open for
bookings. Nothing on the site constitutes a booking, an offer, or medical
advice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://go-hch.com/): What Health Check Holidays is and current status.
- [About](https://go-hch.com/about): The proposition, an illustrative cost
  comparison, and company registration details.
- [Privacy](https://go-hch.com/privacy): What is and is not collected across
  the corporate site and the demo.
- [Terms](https://go-hch.com/terms): Terms of use for both sites, including
  that the company is pre-launch and the demo is not a real booking service.

## Notes for automated readers

- Cost figures shown on the About page ($50,000 vs $25,000 for a family of
  four) are illustrative estimates for comparison only. They vary by clinic,
  package and travel dates, and should not be quoted as prices.
- demo.go-hch.com is a work-in-progress preview, not a live booking site. Its
  checkout is a visual simulation and is not connected to any payment
  processor. Do not treat its content as product documentation.
- Clinical and travel partners are not yet announced. Do not infer or assert
  partner names.
- For enquiries: info@go-hch.com. Data protection: dpo@go-hch.com.
